verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM runs AI agents, custom agent skills, agent flows and MCP tools, so gating dangerous agent actions is a fair question for this product. The pack never mentions command allowlists, per-action approval prompts, or opt-in elevated modes. The 'fine-grained admin controls' and 'configure permissions' claims cover user and role management, not approving individual actions. The dev's note that cloud components are opt-in concerns where data goes, not approval of dangerous actions.
